learning_objective: 🎯 Dive deep into the ocean and learn to draw amazing underwater creatures using basic shapes!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Did you know a fish is just an oval and a triangle put together? We can use simple shapes like circles and half-moons to draw any sea creature!
Once you have the shape of your fish, add tiny details like shiny scales, swishy fins, and little bubbles floating up to the surface.
The ocean is not just one color! Artists use wavy lines and different shades of blue and green to make the water look deep and moving.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Build Your Own Paper Aquarium!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw three different sea creatures using ovals and triangles. Color them brightly, cut them out, and paste them onto a large blue piece of paper to make your own aquarium!

quick_recap: ⭐ Complex animals are easy to draw when we break them down into simple shapes.
⭐ Details like scales and fins bring our ocean friends to life.
⭐ Using wavy lines and blue colors helps create a beautiful underwater background.
